title: Grilled Tofu Skewers with Japanese-Italian Twist
description: A fusion of Japanese and Italian flavors, these grilled tofu skewers are a perfect vegetarian option for a light and refreshing meal.
instructions: Cut tofu into 1-inch cubes and thread onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
In a small bowl, whisk together rice vinegar, honey, and garlic. Brush the mixture onto both sides of the tofu.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the tofu is golden brown and crispy.
Brush with additional honey and sesame seeds during the last minute of grilling.
Garnish with chopped basil leaves and serve immediately.
Let the skewers rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
